Proxy with username and password credentials authenticates successfully

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"never\"},\"proxy\":{\"password\":\"proxypass\",\"url\":\"http://127.0.0.1:8889\",\"username\":\"proxyuser\"},\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages().count)
```
